text:
anya_l: Heads-up — I'm proposing we separate commit duration from HW credit windows in the marketplace private-offer template. Current bundle ties 12/24/36mo commit to hardware credit tranche lengths and it's causing legal/ops complexity.

mike.k: Strong +1. The engineering procurement teams push back when HW credits auto-expire before usage hits.

lucas_p: can you sketch the new flow? do we keep total credit amount the same and just decouple timing?

anya_l: Yes. Proposal in short: keep committed $X for N months, but allow HW-credit vesting to be independently scheduled (e.g., 50% at contract start, 25% at 6mo, 25% at renewal trigger). This avoids forcing customers into longer commits just to get the hardware discount.

sandra_g: Operational question — does Marketplace private-offer support multiple SKU-level entitlements with independent expiry? Heard it's limited.

dealbot: [deploy note] marketplace-private-offer schema v2.3 deployed to staging 02:18 UTC — supports multiple "entitlement_period" entries per offer.

anya_l: @sandra_g fyi — dealbot just confirmed staging support. We'll still need billing integration to honor vesting windows for invoices.

mike.k: For renewals: define a simple rule set. If customer renews before the final vesting tranche, remaining hardware credit rolls into the renewal as a conditional credit with same vesting or convert to cash-equivalent at a defined haircut. Thoughts?

lucas_p: prefer conversion to credit with haircut. Cash conversion complicates revenue recognition. Also need an audit column so finance can reconcile.

sandra_g: Agree on credit conversion. We should propose a standard haircut (e.g., 10-15%) for early termination/rollover to limit abuse. Also add clause: HW credits are non-transferable outside of SIs listed on the PO.

anya_l: Drafting clause now. Will include examples for our sales motions: 12mo commit + 18mo HW vesting (helps frontload infra partners) and 24mo commit + split HW vesting for appliance deals.

mike.k: Can you add sample pricing band snippet for marketplace private-offer? Small snippet helps legal/sales.

anya_l: dropping snippet below — simple JSON for the offer structure we want to use:
```json
{
  "commit": {"amount_usd": 500000, "duration_months": 12},
  "entitlements": [
    {"type":"redwood_credits","amount_usd":40000, "vesting": [{"pct":0.5,"month_offset":0},{"pct":0.25,"month_offset":6},{"pct":0.25,"event":"renewal"}]},
    {"type":"hw_credit","amount_usd":60000, "vesting": [{"pct":1.0,"month_offset":0, "valid_for_months":18}]}
  ]
}
```

lucas_p: clean. For marketplace UI we'll need label mapping so customers see "Appliance credit: $60k — usable for 18 months".

sandra_g: Can we surface the haircut and non-transferability in the offer terms accordion? Sales needs to send to customers without legal edits.

anya_l: yes — plan to add a TL;DR terms block that includes vesting schedule, haircut %, transfer rules, and renewal behavior. I'll iterate and post the draft by EOD.

mike.k: I'll sync with product marketing — we should include a one-line callout in partner co-sell decks. Anyone want to take that?

lucas_p: I'll take co-sell deck snippet. Also pinging @sandra_g for legal blurb.

sandra_g: Got it. I'll draft the blurb and circulate.
